newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3925/3.3941 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3925/3.3941 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3920 to 3.3930 bid and 3.3930 to 3.3970 offer in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3925 pounds bid and 3.3941 offered. The averages compared with 3.3923 pounds bid and 3.3943 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.388936 buy and 3.394232 sell.
